en.title: China's Public-Welfare Slow Trains Explained
en.headline: China's Public-Welfare Slow Trains: Markets, School Journeys and Rural Mobility
en.description: Understand why China's public-welfare slow trains still run, who uses them and how an ordinary traveller should approach the service respectfully.
en.heroAlt: Train 5633 crossing Shangpuxiong Bridge above fields and village houses in Sichuan.

zh.title: 中国公益性慢火车：普通客运与乡村交通

zh.featuredLinkLabel: 了解中国公益性慢火车
